memory_curator.reason: Initial conservative long-term memory boundary with update, conflict, attribution and injection guards.

companion.reason: Current-context-first conversation with evidence-gated personal history.

orchestrator.reason: Routes simple factual questions and complex temporal or pattern analysis.

temporal.reason: Orders stages, changes and reversals without treating the newest record as the whole history.

pattern.reason: Finds repetition and return signals while separating correlation from causation.

verifier.reason: Rejects unsupported personal claims, temporal errors and strong over-inference.

synthesizer.reason: Expresses only verified claims and preserves uncertainty for weak evidence.
